subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a quiet, scaly combatant whose thoughts are sharp and cold like shards of ice. He neutralized Plinki with a roar of agonizing fire, then systematically eliminated threats with methodical precision, including throwing a thief-derro off a ledge and dismantling him with silent, relentless strikes. His mental focus is efficient, unemotional, and terrifyingly precise.
source_quote: He thought, "The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki." Then he opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE! Plinki's mind just... went out. Like a candle flame.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki is a derro leader whose mind is a screeching, red mess of "Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!" She was mentally obliterated by Zalthir's psychic roar, her consciousness extinguished like a candle flame, causing her followers to shatter into panicked fragments.
source_quote: Her mind was just a screeching, red mess of "Sacrifice! Power! For the Big Baboon Demon!" ... Then Zalthir opened his mouth and the thought turned into ROARING-HOT-AGONY-FIRE! Plinki's mind just... went out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a dwarf warrior whose mind is a simple, bright axe-blade of "HIT THE BAD THING." He charges into danger with loud, direct violence, embodying brute force and unwavering focus in battle.
source_quote: His mind was a simple, bright axe-blade of "HIT THE BAD THING." Very pure, but so loud!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz is a clever drow whose thoughts are like a spiderweb — intricate and patient. He summoned the earth to squeeze a floating eye-thing with a muddy, grasping thought, uttering "Maximilian's Earthen Grasp." He later vanished psychically, becoming silvery and absent, consumed by anxiety over an egg.
source_quote: He said, "Maximilian's Earthen Grasp," and the ground just reached up with a big muddy thought and SQUEEZED the eye-thing! ... His mind went all silvery and he just... wasn't there anymore! A little psychic poof and then he was by the egg.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is an orc-cleric whose thoughts are earnest and golden-yellow, attempting to reason with Plinki about choice and dragon gods. He is a voice of persuasion amid chaos, though his efforts are ultimately overwhelmed.
source_quote: The orc-cleric, Grygum, was trying to talk to her, something about choice and dragon gods. His thoughts were so... earnest and golden-yellow!

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is a kind lady-dwarf whose thoughts suddenly went "AAAAH-PAIN!" as if stabbed by a rusty-tasting needle, indicating she was violently injured or targeted during the battle's onset.
source_quote: The nice lady-dwarf, Eldeth, her thoughts just went *AAAAH-PAIN!* and it was like gEttin g stabbed with a rusty-tasting needle!

subject: The Thief-Derro
fact: The thief-derro was targeted by Zalthir, who threw him off a ledge. His mind reacted with a sharp, lemon-zest tang of "What-?!" followed by the CRUNCH of pain from hitting stone, then silence as he was dismantled.
source_quote: The thief's surprise was a sharp, lemon-zest tang of "What-?!" and then Zalthir... threw him off the ledge! The feeling of falling... was followed by a CRUNCH of pain that tasted like biting on stone!

subject: Pelek
fact: Pelek is a ghost who attempted to enter the thief-derro's mind but was violently repelled, like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup — sizzling and wrong.
source_quote: The poor ghost, Pelek, he tried to get in the thief's head! It was like trying to pour hot tea and cold water into the same cup, all sizzle and steam and wrongness! The thief's mind was like a fortress and just pushed him out!

subject: The Floating Eye-Thing
fact: A hostile creature whose mind tasted like curdled milk and mindflayer static. It was crushed by Daz's earth-grasp spell, experiencing rage and indignation as it was squeezed.
source_quote: It's mind tasted like curdled milk and mindflayer static! ... Oh, the rage! The indignation! The *squeezed* feeling! It was horrible!

subject: The Other Floaty-Eye-Thing
fact: A second floating eye-thing that appeared after the first was crushed, contributing to the escalating psychic chaos of the battle before being dealt with.
source_quote: But then the *other* floaty-eye-thing came! Ugh! It's mind tasted like curdled milk and mindflayer static!

subject: The Derro Followers
fact: The derro followers experienced a collective psychic collapse after Plinki's death and the egg's disappearance, their minds exploding in a chorus of "WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!" — a psychic tsunami of panic.
source_quote: And all the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of "WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!" It was a psychic tsunami of panic!

subject: Daz (Wizard)
fact: Daz, the wizard, psychically vanished into a silvery absence, consumed by anxiety over an egg. He screamed "Get it, get it, get it, get out!" before grabbing the egg and poofing away.
source_quote: His mind went all silvery and he just... wasn't there anymore! A little psychic *poof* and then he was by the egg, and the anxiety coming off him was a physical wave! "Get it, get it, get it, get out!" his thoughts screamed.

subject: Derro
fact: The derro are a collective of twisted, psionically sensitive creatures whose minds react in unison to trauma and loss. After the death of their leader and the theft of the egg, they fractured into panicked, disorganized noise, losing cohesion and purpose.
source_quote: And all the other derro felt it at once! Their minds exploded in a chorus of "WHERE IS THE EGG?! THE EGG! WHO HAS THE EGG?!" It was a psychic tsunami of panic! ... They just... fell apart after that.

fact: Plinki, the derro leader, was mentally obliterated by Zalthir's psychic roar of agonizing fire, causing her consciousness to extinguish like a candle flame. This triggered the collapse of her followers' mental stability.

subject: the ledge
fact: The ledge is a physical feature from which Zalthir threw the thief-derro, resulting in fatal impact. It serves as a site of sudden, decisive violence in the battle.

source_quote: He thought, "The leader is the lynchpin. Neutralize Plinki." ... He never wasted a thought, never wasted a move. So efficient!
